plugin.name: True Crime: Streets of LA Fusion Fix
ResX.description: Output width in pixels. Zero uses the desktop resolution. Takes effect after a restart.
ResY.description: Output height in pixels. Zero uses the desktop resolution. Takes effect after a restart.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the corrected field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. Applies immediately. Widening is capped at 150 degrees horizontally.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto spreads the HUD across the whole screen, at its sides. A ratio keeps it in a centred box of that shape. Menus keep their 4:3 layout. Applies immediately.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original shows the movies whole inside the game's centred 4:3 frame. Fill fits the whole movie to the screen. Nothing is cut off or stretched.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a framed window at the selected resolution, or borderless at the monitor resolution. Restart after changing the window mode.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pause the game while another window is active. Turn off to keep the game running in the background. Changes apply immediately.
ConfineCursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the active game client area. Releases on focus loss, window dragging, system menus or when disabled. Independent of mouse input.
FPSLimit.description: Target frame rate: 0 unlimited, -1 current monitor refresh rate, or 30–1000 FPS. Default 60. Changes apply while the game runs. Higher rates may affect game behavior.
SkipIntro.description: Skip the startup studio-logo videos. Story videos remain available. Restart after changing this value.
CutsceneBorders.description: Both keeps the original cinematic frame with borders at any aspect ratio. Off removes the borders and fills the screen, showing more at the sides on wider screens. Letterbox and Pillarbox retain only the named borders.
AnimatedCutsceneBorders.description: Keep the game's sliding top and bottom borders. Off switches them instantly.
CheckForUpdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out; if FusionFixHub is installed, it opens on the update when you close the game. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
ui.textlanguage.description: Language for all plugins' settings texts. Auto follows the game's language with an English fallback.
LeftStickDeadzone.description: Stick movement ignored around the center; lower values respond sooner but may drift.
RightStickDeadzone.description: Stick movement ignored around the center; lower values respond sooner but may drift.
GamepadCameraSpeed.description: Adjust right-stick camera response. Applies immediately.
InvertGamepadY.description: Reverse vertical right-stick input relative to the game setting. Applies immediately.
CameraReturnDelay.description: Seconds without mouse movement before the game camera takes over. Applies immediately.
InvertMouseY.description: Reverse vertical mouse movement for the camera and aiming. Applies immediately.
MouseSensitivity.description: How fast the mouse turns the camera on foot and in cars. Changes take effect immediately.
antialiasing.description: SMAA smooths the edges of the 3D picture. The HUD and menus stay sharp.
consolegamma.description: Deeper contrast and colors, like the Xbox 360 gamma curve.
MouseSteering.description: The game's own Mouse Steering option: on, the mouse steers cars; off (default), the mouse turns the camera around the car. The game's Controls menu changes it too. Changes apply immediately.
